slice.delivers: the density policy, RN's own SafeAreaView and the desktop lanes that prove them, as a slice of GF-09 (density, insets) and GF-18 (the pinned SafeAreaView), leaving the rest to GF-35 (mobile)
slice.v05_08: blocked in PR #102; the iPhone gate of the 0.5 is NO-GO (2026-10-09), so the 0.5 closes as a complete macOS milestone and mobile returns to GF-35

seamValidation.finding: native/fabric_application.cpp, FabricApplication::unsafe_edges: a band of validation_safe_area was cast to double with no type or range check
seamValidation.rule: a band that is there is an int or a float, finite and not below zero; a band that is missing is 0; anything else throws std::runtime_error('validation_safe_area.<side> must be a finite non-negative number'), which the pump reports once and which leaves the last valid metrics in place

oneOffOnTheOldReading.what: the lane run once against a host built with the unchecked static_cast<double>(value) in place of the check, the source restored afterwards
oneOffOnTheOldReading.result: the negative fault fails 4 of its 5 checks (refusal, bands kept, padding kept, no negative padding), the String fault fails 3 (refusal, bands kept, padding kept: the String reads as a valid number), and the NaN fault aborts the Godot process (folly::toJson: JSON object value was a NaN when serializing displayInsets.unsafe.right) so the lane writes no report

validationScreenScale.verdict: no hole, left as it was
validationScreenScale.observed: run once: a String ('abc'), NaN, a negative and an infinity all leave the window at content scale factor 1 (apply_density_policy falls back for a non-finite or non-positive value); a numeric String ('3') is read as 3

hostBinary.note: the same host ran the current lane, the sabotage restore and the windowed run; the sabotaged hosts and the previous host are the controls

departuresFromRN: SafeAreaView's padding is refreshed on every pump, not on safeAreaInsetsDidChange and finalizeUpdates, because Godot has no change signal for the safe area or the frame
The padding is rounded to a pixel of the content scale, where RN rounds at the screen's scale; under density_policy screen they are the same number

Like RN's iOS SafeAreaView the component does not go through View.js, so the aria-*, id and tabIndex mappings of that file do not apply; the facade keeps the View's prop table, explicit roles and style check
UIKit's rule gives a view that hangs outside the window the part of it outside the safe rectangle, so a view 20 points past the window edge keeps a padding of 20 with no insets

openItems.meaning: get_display_safe_area on an iPhone (pixels in screen coordinates, converted by the content scale) and the landscape lock were never exercised: no simulator, no device
the 20-touches and background criteria of V05-08 were not worked on
a SafeAreaView in a Modal shares the unsafe bands of the owner window and the frame measureInWindow gives; it has no case of its own in the lane
the Android safe area is read through the same function and was not exercised

limits: The lanes are macOS arm64: headless for the counts, one windowed run on a Retina display for the pixels; the CI runs the headless lane in native-suites-runtime (dispatch) and the pure C++ test in native-cold-start, and has no windowed lane
There is no simulator and no device run: the iPhone gate of the 0.5 is a NO-GO (2026-10-09), V05-08 was blocked in PR #102 and mobile returns to GF-35
The unsafe bands are the seam's numbers; the iOS and Android reading of get_display_safe_area is not exercised, and macOS's usable rectangle is never read
No 1.0 checkpoint, weight or denominator moves and the dashboard's tasks are not edited
